provenance.notes: Researched definition in tools/extract/patterns/src/extra-2.mjs. Bindings are cited but not all checked against a primary source; roles and key names are cross-checked mechanically against apg-skeleton.json and aria-roles.json. Arabic name is an unreviewed translation.

roles.on: the control that opens the system file dialog
roles.note: A native input type=file, or a button that forwards to a hidden one.

roles.on: visually hidden live region for results

attributes.name: aria-describedby
attributes.values: IDREF of the constraints text (types, size, count)

attributes.name: aria-invalid
attributes.values: true after a rejected file, with the error referenced by aria-describedby

keyboard.action: On the upload button or the focusable dropzone: open the system file dialog.
Move from the button through each file's controls (remove, retry, cancel) in order.
With focus on a file item: remove it, then focus the next item, else the previous, else the upload button.
With focus in the dropzone: add files from the clipboard.
While a drag is over the zone: nothing to bind (the operating system cancels the drag). During an upload, with focus on its item: optionally cancel it.

focus.restore: After the file dialog closes, the browser returns focus to the button. After removing a file: next item, else previous, else the button.
focus.tabStops: The button, plus the controls of each listed file.

data.notes: Dropping files has no keyboard equivalent, so the button is the contract and the dropzone is an enhancement: every dropzone contains or is a real button. Results (added, rejected with reason, uploaded, failed) are announced through a polite status region. Not direction-sensitive. Arabic-first: file names are bidirectional strings (an Arabic name with a Latin extension); isolate each name and keep the extension visible when truncating; sizes use the locale's digits and units.
